minutes.headline: Planning Board agreed to sponsor a self-storage zoning article and to accept cash bonds for 360 Flat Hill Road.
minutes.summary: The board endorsed an ANR plan, then agreed to have staff draft a self-storage warrant article. It was comfortable accepting cash surety for stormwater work at 360 Flat Hill Road. It also scored master plan consultants, with a clear choice emerging, and set the March 27 meeting to start early.

public_comment.topic: Call for public comment at start; none offered.

Asked about the process after selecting a master plan firm, what the final product contains, and when it goes to town meeting; suggested looking at work in Hamilton and Wenham; thanked the board and wished a retiring staff member well.

Planner described a past bond of tens of thousands released after work was completed and why cash surety is better than surety bonds.

what_happened.line: The board agreed by voice vote to have the planner prepare a warrant article on self-storage zoning for town meeting.
The board said it is comfortable accepting cash bonds for stormwater work at 360 Flat Hill Road; estimates and a tri-party agreement return March 27.
Scoring of master plan consultants produced a clear choice; staff will check references and open the price proposals.
The board endorsed an ANR plan removing a lot line at 451 Milpas Road by voice vote.
The March 27 meeting will start early to fit two public hearings before the town caucus.

why_it_matters: A self-storage warrant article, if it reaches the warrant, is a zoning change residents would be asked to vote on at town meeting.
The master plan consultant choice depends on price proposals being within budget, which the board has not yet seen, so the cost of the plan is still undetermined.
